description_short: Classify each thermal ALE chemistry in Table III into one of four mechanistic archetypes and count distinct chemistries and materials per archetype.

paper.title: Thermal atomic layer etching: A review

tables_modeled.label: Table III
tables_modeled.description: Summary of thermal atomic layer etching (ALE) chemistries, including etched material and up to three reactants involved in the ALE cycle.

properties_used.label: material etched
properties_used.role: Identifies the solid being etched in a given thermal ALE chemistry (e.g., SiO2, Al2O3, Si3N4).

properties_used.label: reactant 1
properties_used.role: First reactant used in the thermal ALE sequence (often the initial surface-modifying, fluorinating, or oxidizing species).

properties_used.label: reactant 2
properties_used.role: Second reactant in the thermal ALE sequence, frequently a counter-reactant that forms volatile products.

properties_used.label: reactant 3
properties_used.role: Optional third reactant or treatment step used in some multi-step thermal ALE chemistries.

classification_logic.description: Mechanistic archetypes are assigned via simple keyword rules over the concatenated reactant labels.

archetypes.name: Fluorination + ligand-exchange
archetypes.rule: Reactant text contains 'HF' and at least one of 'TMA', 'DMAC', 'Sn(acac)2', 'Sn(acac)'.

archetypes.name: Oxidation + chelation
archetypes.rule: Reactant text contains 'O2' or 'O3' and at least one of 'Hacac' or 'Hhfac'.

archetypes.name: Halogenation & conversion
archetypes.rule: Reactant text contains 'Cl2' or 'XeF2' and at least one of 'BCl3', 'WF6', 'WCl6', 'TiCl4'.

archetypes.name: Other / unclassified
archetypes.rule: All remaining chemistries not matching the above patterns.

classification_logic.caveats: Classification is heuristic and based on text labels; it does not perform full chemical parsing and may miss edge cases if naming conventions differ strongly.

output_shape.description: One row per mechanism archetype with counts of distinct chemistries and distinct materials.
columns: mechanism: one of the four archetype labels.
n_chemistries: number of distinct reactant tuples (Reactant 1–3) in that archetype.
n_materials: number of distinct etched materials that use chemistries in that archetype.

postprocessing_notes.interpretation: The result summarizes how many unique thermal ALE chemistries and how many different materials fall into each mechanistic family, providing a high-level view of which process design strategies dominate the thermal ALE literature captured in Table III.
